summary: Bolt node starter wrapping a Python FastAPI + Playwright (headless Chromium) Flipkart product-details scraper. No database, no auth, no storage, no payments, no schedules.

capabilities.capability: code: product scraper v2 (layered extraction with extraction_trace, price_with_offers, canonical_url, offer text summaries, cross-field validation)
capabilities.source: scraper.py v2 (Playwright, JSON-LD/embedded state/meta, semantic text, DOM fallback, validation)
capabilities.outcome: migrated to TypeScript (extract.ts) and tuned against two real Flipkart watch pages: MRP from the struck-through price in the main product section, seller only from the seller block, offers grouped into visible cards, highlights as specifications, selected variants; hidden layers and ad carousels ignored
capabilities.next_action: Live check from the published app (sandbox IP receives HTTP 429 from Flipkart)

capabilities.outcome: migrate: JSON info moved to GET /api/public; / now serves a web page to try the API
migrate: GET /api/public/product?url= with the same JSON shape and error codes
migrate: GET /api/public/debug; page HTML returned only when DEBUG_SAVE_HTML=true (no disk on the edge)

capabilities.capability: configuration env vars (PORT, HEADLESS, REQUEST_TIMEOUT_SECONDS, USER_AGENT, DEBUG_SAVE_HTML)
capabilities.outcome: PORT and HEADLESS dropped (hosting-managed, no browser); REQUEST_TIMEOUT_SECONDS, USER_AGENT and DEBUG_SAVE_HTML kept as optional settings
ported to vitest, plus fixture tests on two real watch pages
not needed: Lovable hosts the app; debug scripts were local selector-hunting tools

capabilities.capability: storage / email / payments / AI / schedules / webhooks
